propositions: Read-only derivations over the durable ticket event store must compute agent-process metrics (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass verification rate, rework at 7/30 days, reopen-recovery, revert-linked recovery) using hybrid data access: raw event files for per-event/multi-occurrence metrics and compiled state for single terminal-value metrics.

Metrics requiring per-event data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must read raw event files sorted via event_sort_key, filtered by is_active_event to include compaction-retired events, and skip SNAPSHOT files; metrics requiring only terminal values (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) read compiled state from reduce_ticket.

attempts_per_ticket counts distinct claim sessions from open→in_progress STATUS edges; rework_within_days counts closed→open→closed sequences within n days; reopen_recovery counts all closed→open STATUS edges; first_pass_rate measures tickets never reopened (last_reopened_at absent); revert_recovery counts tickets with substantive reverts (target_event_type STATUS or COMMITS, not COMMENT/LINK).

Metrics over empty ranges return None (Unavailable); metrics over populated ranges with no qualifying events return 0 (measured zero), and all metrics register with source=structural and confidence=high.

Unit tests must verify: two-session tickets yield attempts_per_ticket==2; closed→open→closed 3 days apart counts in rework_within_days(7) but not 10 days; first_pass_rate counts never-reopened tickets; revert_recovery filters by target_event_type; retired events are included.
